walkthrough: spikes/tauri-webview/WALKTHROUGH.md section 1, steps 1-19 (step 20 skipped: Windows contrast theme is a system setting, owner to check)
method: Agent-driven through Claude desktop control (injected keyboard and mouse input). NVDA's speech was read from the NVDA Speech Viewer by screenshot and transcribed by hand; nobody listened. The prototype's --out file was not written because a11y.html never calls the host's report command, so this file was assembled from the Speech Viewer and the page's own announcement log.

host.tauri: 2.12.4 (spike Cargo.lock; the binary was a prebuilt download, TODO(verify) that it matches)

limits: The Speech Viewer shows text, not timing: interruption, delay and the focus-mode sound need someone listening.
NVDA ignores injected input to its own windows (UI Access), so the owner opened the Speech Viewer by hand; the NVDA key could not be pressed.
Injected key-down does not auto-repeat: the held Right arrow of step 17 was approximated with 10 Right presses about 35 ms apart.
The Speech Viewer window was small (about 13 lines); every step was captured right after its keys, so no lines were lost, but lines spoken during the initial say-all were partly scrolled away.
